description: This Java class 'SurveyWrapper' is designed to render and process survey forms within the Apache OFBiz framework, including methods for retrieving survey questions, responses, and generating survey result summaries.

classes.name: SurveyWrapper
classes.description: Class to render and process survey forms, including retrieving questions, responses, and generating survey statistics within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Sets the delegator object for database operations.

methods.name: setPartyId
methods.description: Sets the party ID associated with the survey responses.

methods.name: setSurveyId
methods.description: Sets the survey ID.

methods.name: checkParameters
methods.description: Validates that required parameters (delegator and surveyId) are set.

methods.name: setPassThru
methods.description: Sets pass-through data for hidden form fields.

methods.name: setDefaultValues
methods.description: Sets default values for survey responses.

methods.name: addToTemplateContext
methods.description: Adds an object to the Freemarker template context.

methods.name: removeFromTemplateContext
methods.description: Removes an object from the Freemarker template context.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey using a template path, returning a Writer object.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the survey using a URL and Writer object.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a Freemarker template from a URL.

methods.name: setEdit
methods.description: Sets whether the survey is in edit mode.

methods.name: getSurvey
methods.description: Retrieves the survey entity for the current surveyId.

methods.name: getSurveyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the current survey.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Determines if the survey can be updated based on permissions and survey settings.

methods.name: canRespond
methods.description: Checks if the current user can respond to the survey.

methods.name: getSurveyQuestionAndAppls
methods.description: Retrieves the list of survey questions and applications ordered by sequence.

methods.name: getThisResponseId
methods.description: Gets the most recent survey response ID for the current party and survey.

methods.name: setThisResponseId
methods.description: Sets the current response ID.

methods.name: getNumberResponses
methods.description: Returns the total number of responses for the current survey.

methods.name: getSurveyResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a specific survey question.

methods.name: getResponseAnswers
methods.description: Returns a map of answers for a given response ID, including form data overrides.

methods.name: getQuestionResponses
methods.description: Retrieves responses for a question with pagination, managing transactions.

methods.name: getResults
methods.description: Generates statistical results for a list of questions.

methods.name: getResultInfo
methods.description: Provides detailed statistics for a specific question, including counts, percentages, and averages.

methods.name: getBooleanResult
methods.description: Calculates total, yes, and no counts for boolean questions.

methods.name: getNumberResult
methods.description: Calculates total, tally, and average for numeric questions.

methods.name: getTextResult
methods.description: Counts responses for text questions.

methods.name: getOptionResult
methods.description: Calculates response counts for option-type questions.

methods.name: makeEliCondition
methods.description: Creates entity condition for querying responses to a question.

methods.name: getEli
methods.description: Returns an EntityListIterator for question responses with max rows.
